summary.headline: All 26 candidates were opened at their JSON pointers / markdown passages; every recorded sha256 matched a fresh recomputation; every excerpt is a whitespace-normalised substring of the file cited. 24 authorities verified (identity, text and proposition confirmed, limitations stated), AUTH-M001-025 partially verified (section renumbering unverifiable), AUTH-M001-026 unresolved (placeholder; verifier located Supreme Court dicta in SC Appeal 208/2017 that bears on it). Three points change the substantive picture: (1) Fernando v. Fernando is distinguishable, so the 'half freed on Gamini's death' step is not established; (2) MRIO s.27's application inside s.25 is open against the s.30 per capita default (s.30 not a candidate), so Q02 has two candidate numerical answers; (3) the s.3(1)(d) tree/PDF conflict is real, the PDF text layer is the fuller reading, and the conflict does not change the Q03 answer - but the schema/gate treat it as blocking. Matter status: needs_legal_review; the deterministic gate fails (6 errors, all status/conflict errors, none on traceability). The matter cannot advance to predicates_defined without a lawyer's decisions listed under lawyer_decisions_needed.
lawyer_decisions_needed: Q01: accept the reclassification of CL-M001-Q01-006 (Vinitha's 1991 release of her life interest treated as a conveyancing fact whose effect is an inference; AUTH-M001-026 supporting/unresolved) or reinstate blocked_missing_authority.
Q01: rule on whether, after Gamini's death in 1990, Vinitha's reserved life interest burdened the whole of Lot A or only half (Fernando v. Fernando distinguishable).
Q02: decide whether MRIO s.27 governs the division of the sibling half under s.25 or the s.30 per capita default applies (Kanthi 123/192 vs 61/96; Samantha 53/192 vs 27/96; Ann 1/12 either way).

Q03: close the s.3(1)(d) tree-vs-PDF conflict (verifier: PDF reading correct, no effect on the answer) and the Act 21 of 2018 OCR defects (verifier read the scan), or have the canonical trees corrected.
All: accept that MRIO Part III is held only as current consolidated text with unknown amendment history at the 1995/2022/2023 deaths.

q01_recommendation.question: Is the effect of Vinitha's registered Deed of revocation No. 525 (1991) a legal step that needs cited authority, or a scenario fact whose effect is an inference?
q01_recommendation.recommendation: Reclassify CL-M001-Q01-006 as scenario_inference / scenario_fact with the legal effect flagged needs_legal_review; remove AUTH-M001-026 from Q01's indispensable list (kept as supporting, unresolved); set Q01 to needs_legal_review rather than blocked_missing_authority. Implemented in legal-map.json; a lawyer decides.
justification: Q01 is a pedigree-drawing task (15 marks). In conveyancing practice a deed by which a life-interest holder releases or renounces the interest is recorded as a link in the chain of title on the strength of the instrument itself, exactly as a deed of transfer is recorded without citing authority that a transfer conveys title. The examiner's expected pedigree shows 'life interest of Vinitha released by Deed 525 (1991)'; no authority for the effect of a release is expected.

The corpus does contain Sri Lankan appellate material treating renunciation of a reserved life interest by deed as an ordinary, effective act: SC Appeal 208/2017 (Supreme Court, 9 September 2020) observes that acts done under a life interest 'come to an end ... when the life interest holder renounces the life interest to the property'; SC Appeal 169/2018 and Ferdinandus v. Fernando (1903) 6 NLR 328 narrate such renunciations as effective. None states the rule as a holding, so AUTH-M001-026 stays unresolved.

Nothing in the recorded facts casts doubt on the release: it is notarially attested (PFO s.2 formalities), executed by the holder herself, and no party disputes it. The only open legal question is characterisation (release/renunciation of a personal servitude), not validity.

Keeping Q01 at blocked_missing_authority would block the whole matter on a point the marking scheme does not test, while the genuinely open legal points (Fernando distinguishable; s.25/s.27/s.30 division; MRIO text history) are better surfaced as needs_legal_review items. If the lawyer disagrees, revert CL-M001-Q01-006 to application/inferential, restore AUTH-M001-026 to indispensable, and set Q01 to blocked_missing_authority.
q01_recommendation.alternative_not_chosen: keep Q01 blocked_missing_authority pending an external Roman-Dutch authority (e.g. Voet 7.4) being added to the corpus by a researcher.
